title: Look Up a CVE Record from NVD
description: Retrieve public CVE metadata by a known CVE ID for research.
code:
import json
from urllib.request import urlopen

cve_id = 'CVE-2021-44228'
url = f'https://services.nvd.nist.gov/rest/json/cves/2.0?cveId={cve_id}'
with urlopen(url, timeout=10) as response:
    data = json.loads(response.read())
print('Records returned:', len(data.get('vulnerabilities', [])))

title: Redact Sensitive Evidence Text
description: Mask common token and password patterns before attaching evidence to a report.
code:
import re

def redact(text):
    text=re.sub(r'(?i)(password|token|api_key)=\S+', r'\1=[REDACTED]', text)
    text=re.sub(r'(?i)Bearer\s+[A-Za-z0-9._~+/-]+=*', 'Bearer [REDACTED]', text)
    return text
print(redact('Authorization: Bearer abc123'))

title: Check Website Security Headers and Save Evidence
description: Inspect headers on your own local training site and save a sanitized record.
code:
from urllib.request import urlopen

with urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:8000/',timeout=3) as r:
    selected={k:r.headers.get(k,'MISSING') for k in ['Content-Security-Policy','X-Content-Type-Options','X-Frame-Options','Referrer-Policy']}
open('headers-evidence.txt','w').write('\n'.join(f'{k}: {v}' for k,v in selected.items()))
print('Evidence saved')
